items.title: Foreign delegates arriving for Congress convention
items.blurb: The inaugural event not expected to see a big number of political representatives from abroad, allegedly due to the disasters that struck Nepal recently.

items.title: The children left behind by Nepal’s deadliest floods
items.blurb: The Post spoke to 12 children from the flood-affected areas and gathered their experiences and the nightmares that still follow them.

items.title: Floods drive 33 pregnant women to Kathmandu for childbirth
items.blurb: Local maternity clinics and services remain disrupted in Rasuwa and Nuwakot since the August 26 floods. But many women cannot travel to Kathmandu because of damaged roads.

items.title: Nepal must turn satellite observations into early warnings
items.blurb: If scientists can detect potentially significant deformation after an event, why is there no operational system routinely monitoring for similar changes before disaster strikes?

items.title: Floods disrupt livelihoods of 21,400 workers in Nepal: ILO
items.blurb: The UN agency says damage to homes, workplaces, roads, bridges and energy infrastructure could spread employment and income losses far beyond flood-hit areas.

items.title: Celebrating new China’s remarkable achievements, writing a new chapter in Nepal-China relations
items.blurb: As China marks the 77th anniversary of its founding, its ambassador to Nepal, Zhang Maoming, reflects on the countries’ longstanding ties, growing cooperation and joint response to cross-border disasters.
